subject.title: [improvement] Sub-agent cascade circuit breaker for multi-agent team reliability

question: Should OpenClaw implement this as a subagent-specific circuit breaker, fold it into the broader session-health breaker design, or defer to existing retry and loop guards?
rationale: The remaining work changes config, persisted runtime state, spawn policy, failure taxonomy, UI/CLI status, and operator recovery semantics, which require maintainer product intent before an implementation PR is safe.

options.title: Unify Session And Subagent Health
options.body: Design a shared failure receipt and breaker policy first, then make subagent spawn gating one consumer of that contract.

options.title: Ship Subagent-Only Breaker
options.body: Implement a narrower agents.defaults.subagents.circuitBreaker surface now, accepting that broader session/provider retry policy may need later reconciliation.

options.title: Defer To Existing Guards
options.body: Close or defer this request if maintainers decide current tool-loop, timeout, provider, and session retry protections are sufficient for now.

recommendation.title: Unify Session And Subagent Health
recommendation.body: Design a shared failure receipt and breaker policy first, then make subagent spawn gating one consumer of that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the subagent, config, docs, and state-policy surfaces affected by this product decision.
